020/**
021 * Handle input from NiDsPS4 controllers connected to the Driver Station.
022 *
023 * <p>This class handles NiDsPS4 input that comes from the Driver Station. Each time a value is
024 * requested the most recent value is returned. There is a single class instance for each controller
025 * and the mapping of ports to hardware buttons depends on the code in the Driver Station.
026 *
027 * <p>Only first party controllers from Sony are guaranteed to have the correct mapping, and
028 * only through the official NI DS. Sim is not guaranteed to have the same mapping, as well as any
029 * 3rd party controllers.
030 */

788  /**
789   * Set the rumble output for the HID.
790   *
791   * <p>The DS currently supports 4 rumble values: left rumble, right rumble, left trigger rumble,
792   * and right trigger rumble.
793   *
794   * @param type Which rumble value to set
795   * @param value The normalized value (0 to 1) to set the rumble to
796   */
797  public void setRumble(RumbleType type, double value) {
798    m_hid.setRumble(type, value);
799  }

817    table.log("Triangle", getTriangleButton());

819    table.log("R1", getR1Button());

821    table.log("R2", getR2Button());
